_comment: Rebrand config for scripts/rename-brand.mjs. Edit the *new* fields to the finalized brand, then run: npm run rename:brand -- --check  (preview), then  npm run rename:brand -- --apply  (write). The 'old' fields describe the current brand and normally do not change. IMPORTANT: only the full brand tokens are replaced; the city name 'Pune' on its own is never touched.
